project.name: East Haven
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Full strict-boundary audit completed from local HES Listed Buildings and NRHE datasets. All 16 imported heritage records remain intact: eight records with defensible material periods are visible and eight undated or external-buffer records are map-hidden. East Haven independently qualifies at 68 through its beach, historic fishing-village identity, interpretation, gardens and coastal route. Exact beach parking, picnic and seasonal accessible toilet locations are published; no café or light-lunch venue was found within the village. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.

touristAppeal.label: Good Local Option
touristAppeal.summary: A genuinely worthwhile small coastal village: an award-winning beach, distinctive fishing-community heritage, community gardens, a strong coastal route and unusually complete practical facilities. Its limited scale, seasonal toilets, very small car park and lack of café keep it in the 60–69 band.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: The beach and coastal path are dog-friendly with signed restriction and exercise areas; keep dogs controlled around wildlife, dunes, families and livestock.

townGuide.characterTag: Historic Angus fishing village and community beach
townGuide.headline: A small, cared-for coastal stop with real depth
townGuide.intro: East Haven earns 68% on its own merits and appears on the main map. Combine its beach, fishing-village interpretation and gardens with a section of the Angus coastal path; bring refreshments because there is no café in the village.
perfectFor: A relaxed half-day coast visit without a commercial resort atmosphere
townGuide.visitorMood: Small-scale, welcoming and visibly cared for, with an unusually strong sense of community ownership.
